colors_source: Levarum design system (claude.ai artifact AJSUhz3NtHzzjPKgoysNLi, tokens.json, light theme), read October 30, 2026. Taken as is: ink, ink-muted (muted), ink-faint (faint), accent-text (accent and link; white text on it is 5.9:1), tint (accent_soft and on_accent_soft), mist (gray), rule (border), page, inverse (cover_bg), the hero's bright-blue closer #6fb0dc (cover_eyebrow), on-inverse-muted (cover_faint), success (green, official tag), danger (orange, open tag). Derived, not in the system: orange_fill (a pale ember tint for open cards), cover_sub (the dark-theme charcoal #d4d5d8, used as light text on the cover) and magenta (ill-peri #7d7ddc darkened to 4B4BB0 so the platform tag text is 7:1 on white). Logo: levarum-lockup-inverse.svg rendered to PNG at 1144 px wide; the grain filter does not survive the conversion, the lever shape and colors do. Font stays Inter because the renderer measures fit in Inter (Tait, October 30, 2026).

words.own_meaning: Levarum's own design. A link on the card is background, not backing.
